job.grandline.escort.desc.follow: Escort the merchant %1$s to %2$s. They travel with you: keep them alive, take them aboard your ship and clear the pirates waiting on %2$s's dock, then talk to them there to be paid.
job.grandline.escort.meet: The merchant %1$s joins you, bound for %2$s.
job.grandline.escort.back: There you are! I'm right behind you.
job.grandline.escort.arrived: %1$s at last! Speak to me once the dock is safe.
job.grandline.escort.not_yours: Sorry, friend, I'm already travelling with someone.
job.grandline.escort.lead_on: Lead on to %1$s, I'm right behind you.
job.grandline.escort.clear_dock: Not yet! Those pirates are still on the dock.
job.grandline.escort.thanks: Safe in %1$s! You have my thanks, and your pay.
job.grandline.escort.gave_up: %1$s waited too long for you and found another escort.
job.grandline.list_empty: You have no notice-board jobs in hand.
job.grandline.no_such_job: You have no such notice-board job.
job.grandline.sink.desc: The pirate ship %1$s preys on the waters off %2$s; she was last sighted around %3$s, %4$s. Sail out there, then sink her or take her as a prize.
job.grandline.sink.desc.marine: Marine orders: the pirate ship %1$s, last sighted off %2$s around %3$s, %4$s. Sink her, or bring her in as a prize for a bonus.
job.grandline.sink.desc.bounty_hunter: A price on the whole crew of the %1$s, last sighted off %2$s around %3$s, %4$s. Sink her or take her.
job.grandline.sink.where: The %1$s was last seen off %2$s, around %3$s, %4$s.
job.grandline.sink.sighted: Sighted: the %s, flying the black flag!
job.grandline.sink.prize_bonus: The Marines pay a prize bonus for the %1$s: %2$s Beli.
job.grandline.convoy.desc: The merchantman %1$s sails from %3$s for %2$s and wants an escort: keep your ship beside her until she makes port. Pirates are about.
job.grandline.convoy.desc.marine: Escort duty: see the merchantman %1$s safely from %3$s to %2$s with your ship. Pirates are about.
job.grandline.convoy.start: The %1$s lies off %2$s's dock (around %4$s, %5$s), bound for %3$s. Bring your ship alongside and she will weigh anchor.
job.grandline.convoy.ready: The %s is ready to sail and waits for her escort.
job.grandline.convoy.back: The %s is back on station and waits for her escort.
job.grandline.convoy.under_way: The %1$s weighs anchor for %2$s. Keep close!
job.grandline.convoy.waiting: The %s heaves to: her escort has fallen behind.
job.grandline.convoy.pirates: Pirates! The %1$s bears down on the %2$s!
job.grandline.convoy.sunk: The %s went down with her cargo.
job.grandline.convoy.taken: The %s was taken as a prize.
job.grandline.convoy.gave_up: The %s could wait no longer and sailed without you.
quest.grandline.board_privateer.desc: Beat a pirate ship at sea: sink her or beat her crew.
quest.grandline.board_privateer.pirate.d: Beat a Marine ship at sea: sink her or beat her crew (raises your bounty).
